cervical_exercises.name: Chin Tuck
cervical_exercises.description: Primary activation drill for the deep neck flexors. Create a gentle chin retraction as if making a double chin without flexing or extending the neck.
execution: Position: supine, then progress to seated and standing
Glide the chin straight back (no head tilt)
Hold 10 seconds, relax 5 seconds
2-3 sets x 10 reps
cues: Think "head slides back" not "head tips down"
Keep the throat and jaw relaxed
progressions: Supine -> Seated -> Standing -> Light manual resistance

cervical_exercises.name: Suboccipital Release
cervical_exercises.description: Self-myofascial release for the suboccipital muscles at the base of the skull. Helpful for tension headaches and forward head posture.
execution: Supine with a tennis or lacrosse ball at the base of the skull
Apply moderate pressure and make small "yes" and "no" motions
Hold 60-90 seconds on tender points
Perform 2-3 times per day
common_errors: Too much pressure causing sharp pain
Ball positioned too high on the skull
progressions: Larger ball -> Lacrosse ball -> Add head movement -> Longer holds

cervical_exercises.name: Cervical Rotation Mobility
cervical_exercises.description: Controlled cervical rotation to improve neck mobility.
execution: Sit or stand tall with shoulders relaxed
Slowly rotate the head to one side
Pause briefly at end range
Return to center and repeat to the other side
Perform 2-3 sets of 5-8 reps each direction
progressions: Add gentle overpressure

cervical_exercises.name: Cervical Sidebend Mobility
cervical_exercises.description: Controlled side-bending to improve neck mobility.
execution: Sit or stand tall with shoulders relaxed
Side-bend the head toward one shoulder
Pause briefly at end range
Return to center and repeat on the other side
Perform 2-3 sets of 5-8 reps each direction
progressions: Add gentle overpressure

cervical_exercises.name: Postural Stability Hold (PSH) with Head Movement
cervical_exercises.description: Wall-based postural stability hold emphasizing a stacked cervical position (chin gently retracted) while adding controlled head movements. Goal: maintain cranio-cervical control without rib flare or shoulder elevation.
execution: Stand with back against a wall: sacrum, mid-back, and head lightly in contact (as tolerated).
Set a gentle chin retraction (no neck flexion).
Maintain relaxed jaw and steady nasal breathing.
Perform small head movements: rotate left/right 10–20° OR nod 'yes' in a very small range.
Keep ribs down and shoulders relaxed throughout.
2–3 sets of 20–40 seconds (or 6–10 controlled reps per direction).
cues: Move the head, not the whole trunk
common_errors: Turning the torso instead of the head
progressions: Isometric hold only (no movement) -> add slow nods -> add slow rotation
Increase time under tension
Add light tactile cue (towel behind occiput) to maintain alignment

cervical_exercises.name: Cervical Rotation with Towel
cervical_exercises.description: Assisted cervical rotation using a towel to guide rotation while limiting side-bend. Useful when rotation is restricted or asymmetrical.
execution: Sit tall. Loop a towel around the back of your head (occiput).
Hold towel ends in front, keeping tension light.
Rotate head slowly toward the limited side while maintaining a neutral chin position.
Use the towel to assist slightly at end range (no forcing).
Pause 1–2 seconds, return to center.
2–3 sets x 6–10 reps each side.
cues: Rotate around a vertical axis (avoid side-bending)
progressions: Active rotation only -> towel-assisted -> add isometric hold at end range (3–5 sec)

cervical_exercises.name: Deep Neck Flexor (DNF) Activation
cervical_exercises.description: Corrective exercise deep neck flexor activation to complement chin tucks (Falla, Jull).
execution: Supine with a small towel under the occiput
Gently retract the chin
Add a small nod (craniocervical flexion)
Hold 10 seconds, repeat
cues: Keep the head on the floor
progressions: Chin tuck only -> Head lift -> Longer holds -> Add arm movement

cervical_exercises.name: Upper Trapezius and Levator Scapulae Stretch
cervical_exercises.description: Corrective exercise stretches for upper trapezius and levator scapulae (Kendall).
execution: Seated, bring ear toward shoulder
Upper trap: look toward the opposite knee
Levator: look toward the armpit
Hold 30-60 seconds per side
progressions: Short holds -> Longer holds -> Add contract-relax -> Seated/standing

shoulder_exercises.name: Scapular Squeeze
shoulder_exercises.description: Basic activation drill for scapular retractors. A foundational corrective for rounded shoulders.
execution: Seated or standing with arms at your sides
Pull the shoulder blades back and down
Hold 5-10 seconds, release slowly
3 sets x 12-15 reps
cues: Imagine holding a pencil between the shoulder blades
progressions: Seated -> Standing -> Add band resistance -> Holds

shoulder_exercises.name: Y-T-W-I Series
shoulder_exercises.description: Prone sequence to strengthen the posterior shoulder and scapular musculature.
execution: Prone on a bench or stability ball
Y: Arms diagonal overhead (about 135 deg)
T: Arms straight out to the sides (90 deg)
W: Elbows flexed with external rotation
I: Arms by the sides with external rotation
2-3 sets x 10-12 each position
progressions: No load -> Light load (1-3 lb) -> Moderate load

shoulder_exercises.name: Face Pull
shoulder_exercises.description: Horizontal pull with external rotation. Excellent for rounded shoulders and scapular dyskinesis.
execution: Cable or band set at face height
Pull toward the face while separating the hands
Externally rotate at the end of the pull
Finish with full scapular retraction
3 sets x 15 reps
cues: Separate the hands at the end
common_errors: Pulling down instead of toward the face
progressions: Light band -> Cable -> Add external rotation -> Tempo

shoulder_exercises.name: Scapular Push-Up
shoulder_exercises.description: Serratus anterior activation drill. Key for scapular stability and reducing winging.
execution: Plank or push-up position (wall version for beginners)
Keep elbows straight and push the floor away to protract
Allow the shoulder blades to come together
Range of motion about 3-4 inches
3 sets x 15-20 reps
cues: Move only at the shoulder blades
progressions: Wall -> Knees -> Plank -> Traditional push-up -> With load

shoulder_exercises.name: Wall Slide
shoulder_exercises.description: Mobility and motor-control drill for the shoulder complex. Trains proper scapular upward rotation.
execution: Back against a wall, feet about 6 inches forward
Arms in a "W" position against the wall
Slide the arms up while keeping contact
Lower under control
3 sets x 10 reps
progressions: Supine wall slide -> Standing wall slide -> Add band -> Add lift-off

shoulder_exercises.name: Band External Rotation
shoulder_exercises.description: External rotation drill with a band for rotator cuff activation.
execution: Stand with elbow at 90 deg and tucked to the side
Hold band with neutral wrist
Rotate the forearm outward without moving the elbow
Pause briefly and return with control
Perform 2-3 sets x 12-15 reps
progressions: Light band -> Heavier band -> 90/90 position

shoulder_exercises.name: Shoulder Press
shoulder_exercises.description: Overhead pressing movement for shoulder strength and control.
execution: Stand or sit with dumbbells at shoulder height
Brace the core and press overhead
Keep ribs down and elbows under wrists
Lower under control to the start
Perform 3 sets x 8-12 reps
progressions: Seated -> Standing -> Single-arm

shoulder_exercises.name: Push-Up
shoulder_exercises.description: Standard push-up to develop upper body pushing strength and core stability.
execution: Start in a plank with hands under shoulders
Lower chest toward the floor with control
Keep elbows at a comfortable angle
Press back to the start without sagging
Perform 2-3 sets x 8-15 reps
cues: Maintain a straight line head to heels
progressions: Incline -> Floor -> Decline -> Loaded

shoulder_exercises.name: Wall Elbow Walk with Band
shoulder_exercises.target: Serratus anterior, lower trapezius, scapular stabilizers
shoulder_exercises.description: Corrective exercise wall drill to activate scapular upward rotation with band tension (Kibler et al.).
execution: Stand facing a wall with forearms on the wall
Band around the wrists
Slide forearms up while keeping pressure on the wall
Maintain band tension throughout
progressions: Light band -> Heavier band -> Longer range -> Add hold

shoulder_exercises.name: Y Raise on Swiss Ball
shoulder_exercises.description: Corrective exercise Y-raise to target lower traps and serratus (Kibler et al.).
execution: Prone on a Swiss ball with chest supported
Arms hanging toward the floor
Raise arms into a Y with thumbs up
Keep scapulae depressed
Lower under control
progressions: Prone Y on floor -> Swiss ball -> Add load -> Tempo

shoulder_exercises.name: Sphinx with Reach
shoulder_exercises.description: Corrective exercise serratus activation in thoracic extension using a sphinx position (Kibler et al.).
execution: Prone on forearms (sphinx)
Reach one arm forward
Keep the torso stable
Alternate arms
progressions: Small reach -> Full reach -> Add thoracic rotation -> Add hold

shoulder_exercises.name: Scapular Activation
shoulder_exercises.description: Corrective exercise drill for scapular control through isolated scapular motions (Kibler et al.).
execution: Quadruped or standing
Isolate scapular movement only
Protract, retract, elevate, depress
Focus on quality and control
progressions: Isometric scap set -> Small movement -> Full ROM -> Add band

core_exercises.name: Dead Bug
core_exercises.description: Foundational anti-extension core drill. Teaches neutral spine control while moving the limbs.
execution: Supine, hips and knees at 90 deg, arms to the ceiling
Extend opposite arm and leg together
Keep the low back flat on the floor
Alternate sides with control
3 sets x 10 reps per side
cues: Low back stays glued to the floor
progressions: Arms only -> Legs only -> Alternating -> Bilateral

core_exercises.name: Plank
core_exercises.description: Isometric anti-extension hold to build core endurance.
execution: Prone on forearms and toes
Body in a straight line from head to heels
Slight posterior pelvic tilt
Hold 30-60 seconds, 3-4 sets
progressions: Knees -> Toes -> Elevated feet -> Single leg

core_exercises.name: Bird Dog
core_exercises.description: Quadruped stability drill for coordination and anti-rotation control.
execution: Quadruped with a neutral spine
Extend opposite arm and leg together
Hold 3-5 seconds, return to start
Avoid pelvic or trunk rotation
3 sets x 10 per side
progressions: Arm only -> Leg only -> Alternating -> Paused -> With movement

core_exercises.name: Pallof Press
core_exercises.description: Anti-rotation core exercise with lateral resistance. Builds rotational stability.
execution: Standing or half-kneeling, band/cable at chest height
Stand perpendicular to the resistance
Press hands forward while resisting rotation
Hold 2-3 seconds, return
3 sets x 10-12 per side
progressions: Half-kneeling -> Standing -> Split stance -> Single leg

core_exercises.name: Side Plank
core_exercises.description: Anti-lateral flexion hold to strengthen the lateral core.
execution: Side-lying on forearm and edge of the foot
Lift hips to form a straight line
Hold 30-45 seconds per side
3 sets per side
progressions: Knees -> Feet -> Top leg elevated -> With hip movement

core_exercises.name: Posterior Pelvic Tilt Drill
core_exercises.description: Supine drill to learn and control posterior pelvic tilt.
execution: Lie supine with knees bent and feet flat
Gently flatten the low back into the floor
Hold the tilt for 3-5 seconds
Relax to neutral and repeat
Perform 2-3 sets x 8-12 reps
progressions: Add heel slides -> Dead bug

core_exercises.name: Plank Roll
core_exercises.description: Anti-rotation plank variation that challenges trunk stability while controlling scapular position.
cues: Maintain a neutral spine and steady scapular position
Rotate slowly without shifting the hips
Keep ribs down and breathe steadily
progressions: Add band resistance
Increase time under tension
Use a narrower base of support
core_exercises.reference: Anti-rotation plank; core stability. McGill SM. Low Back Disorders. Human Kinetics.

core_exercises.name: Pelvic Alignment Correction
core_exercises.description: Corrective exercise drill to find and maintain neutral pelvic alignment.
execution: Supine with knees bent
Find neutral pelvis between anterior and posterior tilt
Maintain alignment while moving the limbs
Progress to more challenging positions
cues: Keep a natural space under the low back
common_errors: Losing neutral pelvis when legs move
progressions: Supine pelvic tilt -> Seated -> Standing alignment -> Add breathing

core_exercises.name: Trunk Stability Roll
core_exercises.description: Corrective exercise trunk control drill to improve segmental rolling and core coordination (DNS/Cook).
execution: Supine with arms extended
Roll to one side using the trunk only
Avoid using arm or leg momentum
Return with control
progressions: Assisted roll -> Full roll -> Add pause -> Add light load

core_exercises.name: Modified Side Plank with Band
core_exercises.description: Corrective exercise side plank variation with banded hip abduction.
execution: Side-lying with band at the knees
Support on forearm and knees
Lift hips while abducting the top knee
Hold 15-30 seconds
progressions: Side plank from knees -> Band resistance -> Full side plank -> Longer holds

hip_glute_exercises.name: Glute Bridge
hip_glute_exercises.description: Foundational glute activation drill. A base movement for hip thrust variations and APT correction.
execution: Supine with knees bent and feet flat near the glutes
Drive through the heels to lift the hips into a straight line
Squeeze the glutes at the top
Hold 2-3 seconds, lower under control
3 sets x 12-15 reps
cues: Squeeze the glutes at the top
progressions: Bilateral -> Single leg -> Elevated feet -> With load

hip_glute_exercises.name: Clamshell
hip_glute_exercises.description: Gluteus medius activation drill. Key for knee valgus control and pelvic stability.
execution: Side-lying with hips and knees flexed 45-90 deg
Keep feet together and open the top knee
Avoid pelvic rotation
3 sets x 15-20 per side
common_errors: Excess range with loss of form
progressions: No band -> Band -> Pause at top -> Pulses

hip_glute_exercises.name: Hip Hitch (Pelvic Drop Correction)
hip_glute_exercises.target: Gluteus medius, frontal plane pelvic control
hip_glute_exercises.description: Standing single-leg exercise where the pelvis is allowed to drop on the non-stance side and then actively corrected by the stance-leg hip abductors. Widely used in rehabilitation for hip drop and knee valgus control.
execution: Stand on one leg on a step or floor, other foot free
Allow the pelvis to drop slightly on the non-stance side
Actively lift the pelvis back to level using the stance-leg gluteus medius
Hold 2–3 seconds at top, then control the drop
2–3 sets x 10–15 reps per side
cues: Keep the stance knee aligned over the foot
Lift from the lateral hip, not the trunk
Avoid trunk lean to the stance side
common_errors: Trunk lean instead of pelvic correction
Hiking the shoulder or rotating the pelvis
Letting the stance knee drift into valgus
progressions: Step height: lower -> higher
Add light band around knees
Eyes closed or unstable surface
hip_glute_exercises.reference: Clinical rehabilitation; EMG meta-analysis (gluteus medius loading).

hip_glute_exercises.name: Monster Walk
hip_glute_exercises.description: Band-resisted lateral walk to strengthen hip abductors in a loaded stance.
execution: Band around knees or ankles
Partial squat, step laterally/diagonally
Keep knees out and resist valgus
3 sets x 10 steps each direction
progressions: Band at knees -> Ankles -> More tension -> More depth

hip_glute_exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
hip_glute_exercises.description: Primary hip flexor stretch. Essential for anterior pelvic tilt correction.
execution: Half-kneeling position with the back leg being stretched
Squeeze the glute of the back leg
Posteriorly tilt the pelvis
Shift forward until a stretch is felt
Hold 45-60 seconds, 3 sets
cues: Tuck the pelvis, do not arch
progressions: Basic -> Arms overhead -> Rotation -> PNF contract-relax

hip_glute_exercises.name: Single Leg RDL
hip_glute_exercises.description: Unilateral hip hinge to build strength, balance, and hip control.
execution: Stand on one leg with a soft knee
Hinge from the hip as the free leg reaches back
Keep a neutral spine and square hips
Return by squeezing the glute
3 sets x 8-10 per side
cues: Hinge from the hip, not the low back
Hip, knee, and torso stay aligned
Drive the floor with the stance foot
progressions: Bodyweight -> Contralateral load -> Ipsilateral load -> Barbell

hip_glute_exercises.name: Single-Leg Deadlift (SLDL)
hip_glute_exercises.description: Unilateral hip hinge to build posterior chain strength and balance.
execution: Stand on one leg with a soft knee and neutral spine
Hinge at the hip as the free leg reaches back
Keep hips square and shoulders level
Return by driving through the stance foot and squeezing the glute
3 sets x 6-10 reps per side
cues: Hinge from the hip, not the low back
progressions: Bodyweight -> Contralateral load -> Ipsilateral load -> Tempo reps

hip_glute_exercises.name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction
hip_glute_exercises.description: Glute med strengthening drill to improve pelvic stability.
execution: Lie on your side with legs straight
Keep the top leg slightly behind the body
Lift the top leg to hip height without rotating
Lower with control
Perform 2-3 sets x 12-15 reps per side
progressions: Add mini band -> Hold at top

hip_glute_exercises.name: Hip Flexor Strengthening
hip_glute_exercises.description: Hip flexor strengthening drill for improved hip control.
execution: Sit tall on a bench or on the floor
Lift one knee toward the chest with control
Pause briefly at the top
Lower slowly without leaning back
Perform 2-3 sets x 10-12 reps per side
progressions: Add ankle weight -> Isometric holds

hip_glute_exercises.name: Reverse Goblet Lunge with Band
hip_glute_exercises.description: Reverse lunge with a goblet hold and band resistance to reinforce trunk stability and hip control.
cues: Keep torso tall and ribs stacked over pelvis
Step back under control and keep front knee tracking
Maintain band tension through the full range
progressions: Increase load
Add tempo or pause at the bottom
Use a narrower stance
hip_glute_exercises.reference: Lunge with anterior load and band; trunk and hip control. Cook G. Movement: Functional Movement Systems. 2011.

hip_glute_exercises.name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
hip_glute_exercises.description: Corrective exercise single-leg hip thrust for advanced glute activation.
execution: Supine with one knee to the chest
Working foot on the floor
Drive through the heel to lift the hips
Squeeze the glute at the top, lower under control
progressions: Double-leg -> Single-leg -> Elevated -> Loaded

hip_glute_exercises.name: Lateral Step with Mini Band
hip_glute_exercises.description: Corrective exercise lateral steps with mini band for hip abductor activation.
execution: Band around ankles or knees
Athletic stance with slight knee bend
Step laterally while maintaining tension
Do not bring feet fully together
progressions: Light band -> Heavier band -> Longer steps -> Add tempo

hip_glute_exercises.name: Standing Fire Hydrant with Mini Band
hip_glute_exercises.description: Corrective exercise standing hip abductor drill with band resistance.
execution: Stand with a band around the knees
Balance on one leg
Abduct and externally rotate the free leg
Keep the pelvis stable
progressions: Bodyweight -> Band -> Add hold -> Add reach

lower_leg_exercises.name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Mobilization (Band)
lower_leg_exercises.description: Joint mobilization to improve ankle dorsiflexion. Essential for deep squat mechanics.
execution: Band around the ankle, anchored behind
Assume a lunge and drive the knee over the toes
Allow the band to glide the talus backward
15-20 reps with progressive range
3 sets per ankle
cues: Knee tracks over the second toe
progressions: Static -> Dynamic -> More distance -> Squat position

lower_leg_exercises.name: Calf Stretch (Gastrocnemius and Soleus)
lower_leg_exercises.description: Two-position calf stretch for gastrocnemius and soleus.
execution: Gastrocnemius: back leg straight, lean toward wall
Soleus: back knee bent in the same position
Keep heel down and arch active
3 sets x 45-60 seconds each
cues: Feel the stretch in the calf
progressions: Wall -> Step -> Loaded -> PNF

lower_leg_exercises.name: Short Foot Exercise
lower_leg_exercises.description: Foot intrinsic activation to build arch control and reduce pronation.
execution: Seated or standing, barefoot
Shorten the foot by drawing the ball toward the heel
Lift the medial arch without curling the toes
Hold 5-10 seconds, relax
3 sets x 15-20 reps
progressions: Seated -> Standing -> Single leg -> During gait

lower_leg_exercises.name: Single Leg Heel Raise
lower_leg_exercises.description: Single-leg calf strength exercise; also a functional test for posterior tibialis.
execution: Stand on one leg (light wall support if needed)
Rise onto the ball of the foot
Lower under control (eccentric focus)
3 sets x 15-25 reps
If you cannot reach 25, weakness is likely
progressions: With support -> No support -> From a step -> With load

lower_leg_exercises.name: Eccentric Calf Raises
lower_leg_exercises.description: Eccentric-focused calf raises to build tendon capacity and control.
execution: Stand on a step with the forefoot and heels free
Rise up with both feet
Shift weight to one leg and lower slowly for 3-5 seconds
Use both feet to return to the top
Perform 2-3 sets x 6-10 reps per side
cues: Keep knee straight for gastroc, bent for soleus
progressions: Bodyweight -> Add load -> Increase tempo control

lower_leg_exercises.name: Tibialis Strengthening
lower_leg_exercises.description: Anterior tibialis strengthening to improve dorsiflexion control.
execution: Sit with legs extended and heels on the floor
Loop a band around the forefoot
Pull toes toward the shin against resistance
Pause briefly at the top
Perform 2-3 sets x 12-15 reps
progressions: Light band -> Heavier band -> Isometric holds

lower_leg_exercises.name: Single-Leg Balance
lower_leg_exercises.description: Single-leg balance drill to improve proprioception and stability.
execution: Stand tall on one leg with a soft knee
Hold balance for 20-30 seconds
Maintain a level pelvis and quiet foot
Repeat 2-3 times per side
progressions: Eyes closed -> Unstable surface -> Reach tasks

lower_leg_exercises.name: Gastrocnemius/Soleus Stretch
lower_leg_exercises.description: Wall calf stretch targeting both gastrocnemius and soleus.
execution: Stand facing a wall in a split stance
Keep the back heel down and knee straight to target gastroc
Hold 30-45 seconds
Slightly bend the back knee to target soleus
Hold 30-45 seconds per side
progressions: Longer holds -> Add contract-relax

lower_leg_exercises.name: Posterior Tibialis Activation
lower_leg_exercises.description: Corrective exercise posterior tibialis activation to support the arch and reduce pronation.
execution: Seated or standing
Without moving the foot, attempt to shorten the arch
Slightly invert the heel to activate posterior tibialis
Hold 10 seconds, repeat
cues: Lift the arch without curling toes
common_errors: Toe curling to create the arch
progressions: Isometric -> Band resistance -> Single-leg stance -> Dynamic

knee_exercises.name: Terminal Knee Extension (TKE)
knee_exercises.description: Closed-chain quad activation drill emphasizing the VMO. Common in knee rehab and patellofemoral pain.
execution: Band behind the knee, anchored in front at knee height
Start with slight knee bend, extend fully against the band
Squeeze the quad at full extension
3 sets x 15-20 reps
progressions: Light band -> Heavy band -> Add slight squat -> Single leg

knee_exercises.name: Lateral Step Down
knee_exercises.description: Unilateral control drill for knee valgus and lower limb alignment.
execution: Stand on a step/box (4-8 inches)
Lower the free leg laterally with control
Keep the stance knee from collapsing inward
Tap the heel to the floor, return to start
3 sets x 10 reps per side
progressions: Low step -> Higher step -> Slower tempo -> With load -> Eyes closed

knee_exercises.name: Wall Sit
execution: Back against the wall, knees at about 90 deg
Feet shoulder-width apart
Hold 30-60 seconds
3-4 sets
progressions: Angle >90 deg -> 90 deg -> <90 deg -> Single leg -> With load

thoracic_exercises.name: Thoracic Extension on Foam Roller
thoracic_exercises.description: Passive thoracic extension mobilization. Foundational for reducing kyphosis and forward head posture.
execution: Supine with a foam roller perpendicular under the shoulder blades
Hands behind the head supporting the neck
Extend over the roller and hold for 5 deep breaths
Move the roller 2-3 inches and repeat
Work from T1 to T12
cues: Breathe slowly into the rib cage
Extend through the thoracic spine, not the neck
common_errors: Extending the neck instead of the thoracic spine
Rolling too low into the lumbar spine
progressions: Static holds -> Add arm movement -> Add rotations

thoracic_exercises.name: Cat-Cow
thoracic_exercises.description: Dynamic spinal mobility drill to improve segmental control and awareness.
execution: Quadruped with hands under shoulders and knees under hips
COW: Inhale and extend the spine, gaze slightly up
CAT: Exhale and flex the spine, tuck the chin
Move slowly through the entire spine
3 sets x 10 reps
progressions: Basic -> Thoracic emphasis -> Add rotations -> Quadruped rocks

thoracic_exercises.name: Thread the Needle
thoracic_exercises.description: Quadruped thoracic rotation drill to improve rotational mobility.
execution: Quadruped with one hand on the floor and the other behind the head
Rotate the elbow up (thoracic opening)
Thread the arm under the body to rotate down
3 sets x 10 reps per side
cues: Rotate from the rib cage, not the arm
Follow the elbow with your eyes
progressions: No load -> Pause at top -> More range -> Light load

thoracic_exercises.name: Open Book Stretch
thoracic_exercises.description: Side-lying thoracic rotation to open the chest and improve upper-back mobility.
execution: Side-lying with hips and knees at 90 deg, arms extended forward
Rotate the top arm open like a book
Follow the hand with the eyes, keep knees stacked
3 sets x 10 reps per side
progressions: Passive -> Active -> Pause at end -> Foam roller between knees

thoracic_exercises.name: Prone Press-Up
thoracic_exercises.description: Prone press-up to restore spinal extension mobility.
execution: Lie prone with hands under shoulders
Press the chest up while keeping hips on the floor
Pause briefly at end range
Lower with control
Perform 2-3 sets x 8-10 reps
progressions: Increase range -> Add pauses

thoracic_exercises.name: T-Spine Foam Roll
thoracic_exercises.description: Corrective exercise thoracic mobilization with a foam roller.
execution: Supine on a roller perpendicular to the spine
Place roller at mid-thoracic level
Arms crossed or behind the head
Extend over the roller segment by segment
cues: Move one segment at a time
progressions: Short range -> Full range -> Add extensions -> Add reach

thoracic_exercises.name: T-Spine Rotation
thoracic_exercises.description: Corrective exercise thoracic rotation drill to improve rotational mobility.
execution: Quadruped or side-lying
Lock lumbar spine and hips
Rotate thorax, reaching the hand to the ceiling
Follow the hand with the eyes
progressions: Small range -> Full range -> Add breath hold -> Add resistance band

smr_mobilization.name: TFL/IT Band Foam Rolling
smr_mobilization.description: SMR for the TFL/IT band. Helpful for knee valgus, hip drop, and IT band syndrome.
execution: Side-lying on a foam roller along the lateral thigh
Top leg crosses in front for support
Roll from just below the hip to above the knee
Pause 20-30 seconds on tender points
2-3 minutes per side
cues: Avoid rolling directly on the hip bone or knee
common_errors: Too much pressure causing sharp pain
progressions: Top leg support -> Both legs on roller for more intensity

smr_mobilization.name: Adductor Foam Rolling
smr_mobilization.description: SMR for the adductors. Useful for limited hip abduction and valgus patterns.
execution: Prone with roller perpendicular to the body
One leg abducted with the inner thigh on the roller
Roll from the groin to the inner knee
Pause 20-30 seconds on tender points
2 minutes per side
common_errors: Rolling too close to the groin
progressions: Less body weight -> More body weight -> Lacrosse ball for specific points

smr_mobilization.name: Pec Minor Lacrosse Ball Release
smr_mobilization.description: Targeted release for the pec minor. Key for rounded shoulders and scapular dyskinesis.
execution: Stand facing a wall, ball under the clavicle and lateral to the sternum
Lean into the wall for pressure
Hold 60-90 seconds on tender points
Option: move the arm slowly while maintaining pressure
2-3 points per side
progressions: Static -> Add arm motion -> Increase pressure

smr_mobilization.name: Lat Foam Rolling
smr_mobilization.description: Lat release to improve shoulder flexion and thoracic extension.
execution: Side-lying with roller under the armpit/side
Bottom arm extended overhead
Roll from the armpit to mid-side
Pause 20-30 seconds on tender points
2 minutes per side
progressions: Foam roller -> Lacrosse ball for more pressure

smr_mobilization.name: Quad Foam Rolling
smr_mobilization.description: Quadriceps SMR for APT, knee pain, and limited knee flexion.
execution: Prone with roller under the front of the thighs
Forearms on the floor for support
Roll from above the knees to the hip
Pause 20-30 seconds on tender points
2-3 minutes
common_errors: Staying only on the rectus femoris
progressions: Both legs -> Single leg -> Lacrosse ball

compound_movements.name: Goblet Squat
compound_movements.description: Loaded squat holding a kettlebell or dumbbell at the chest to reinforce upright posture and depth.
execution: Hold a kettlebell or dumbbell at chest height
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart
Sit hips down and back while keeping the chest tall
Keep knees tracking over the feet
Drive through midfoot to stand, 3 sets x 8-12 reps
cues: Elbows inside the knees at the bottom
progressions: Bodyweight squat -> Goblet squat -> Front squat

compound_movements.name: Goblet Squat Hold
compound_movements.target: Hip mobility, deep squat, core control
compound_movements.description: Deep goblet squat isometric to improve hip mobility and dorsiflexion while reinforcing upright squat posture.
execution: Hold a kettlebell/dumbbell at the chest (goblet position)
Descend to the deepest controlled squat
Keep heels down and torso tall
Use elbows to press knees out
Hold 30-60 seconds x 3-5 sets
progressions: Box squat hold -> Goblet hold -> Overhead hold

compound_movements.name: Squat to Box
compound_movements.target: Hip hinge control, lumbopelvic stability, squat pattern re-education
compound_movements.description: Constraint-based squat using a box or bench to control depth and reinforce proper lumbopelvic mechanics. The box acts as external feedback to limit excessive lumbar motion, improve hip contribution, and reduce anterior chain dominance during the squat pattern.
execution: Stand facing away from a box or bench set at knee height or slightly above.
Feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out as needed.
Set ribs down and pelvis neutral; brace lightly before initiating the movement.
Sit the hips back and down toward the box, maintaining a neutral spine.
Lightly touch the box without fully relaxing.
Drive through mid-foot and heels to stand, extending hips first.
2–4 sets of 6–10 controlled repetitions.
cues: Hips back and down, not straight down
Control the descent, don't drop onto the box
Stand up by pushing the floor away
common_errors: Relaxing completely on the box (losing tension)
Lumbar flexion or excessive posterior pelvic tilt at the bottom
Anterior knee dominance with minimal hip contribution
Rib flare or lumbar extension during ascent
progressions: Higher box -> lower box
Pause 2–3 seconds on the box while maintaining tension
Goblet-loaded squat to box
Remove box and progress to free squat when control is consistent

compound_movements.name: Ball Wall Push with Hip Hinge
compound_movements.target: Hip hinge patterning + serratus/shoulder stability + trunk stack
compound_movements.description: Press a ball into a wall to create shoulder stability while practicing a clean hip hinge. Great for teaching 'hips back' without rib flare or lumbar extension.
execution: Place a ball (soft medicine ball or playground ball) between forearms/hands and the wall at chest height.
Set ribs down and pelvis neutral; lightly brace.
Press the ball into the wall (steady pressure) without shrugging.
Perform a hip hinge: send hips back, slight knee bend, keep spine neutral.
Return to standing by driving hips forward (glutes) while keeping pressure on the ball.
2–4 sets x 6–10 reps with slow tempo.
cues: Keep pressure on the ball but shoulders down
No rib flare at the bottom
common_errors: Turning it into a squat (knees forward, hips not back)
Lumbar extension / rib flare during hinge
progressions: Short-range hinge -> deeper hinge
Add 2–3 sec pause at end range
Increase ball pressure slightly
Progress to loaded hinge patterns when control is consistent

compound_movements.name: Incline Push-Up
compound_movements.target: Chest, triceps, serratus anterior, core anti-extension
compound_movements.description: Push-up regression that reduces load while training the horizontal push pattern.
execution: Hands on an elevated surface (bench, box, bar)
Body in a straight line from heels to head
Lower the chest to the surface (elbows 20-45 deg)
Press to full extension with scapular protraction
3-4 sets x 8-15 reps
progressions: More upright -> More horizontal -> Floor push-up

compound_movements.name: Half-Kneeling Press
compound_movements.target: Deltoids, core anti-extension and anti-rotation, glute stability
compound_movements.description: Half-kneeling overhead press to reduce lumbar compensation and reinforce core control.
execution: Half-kneeling with the press-side knee down
Dumbbell/kettlebell in rack position
Press vertically while keeping the torso tall
Glute engaged and ribs down
3-4 sets x 6-10 reps per side
cues: Squeeze the glute on the down knee
progressions: Tall kneeling -> Half kneeling -> Standing press

compound_movements.name: Landmine Press
compound_movements.target: Deltoids (anterior emphasis), upper chest, serratus, core
compound_movements.description: Angled press with a landmine or corner anchor. Friendly on shoulder mobility with a natural arc.
execution: Bar anchored in a landmine or corner
Grip the bar end in an athletic stance
Press up and slightly forward along the arc
Control the return
3-4 sets x 8-12 reps
progressions: Kneeling -> Half-kneeling -> Standing -> Single arm

compound_movements.name: Overhead Squat
compound_movements.target: Full-body squat pattern with shoulder stability
compound_movements.description: Squat pattern with arms overhead to challenge mobility and stability.
execution: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart
Raise arms overhead with elbows extended
Squat to depth with control
Keep heels down and torso upright
Perform 2-3 sets x 6-10 reps
progressions: Bodyweight -> Add dowel -> Light load

compound_movements.name: Dowel Hip Hinge
compound_movements.description: Hip hinge pattern to teach lumbopelvic dissociation (McGill, Cook).
execution: Standing, feet shoulder-width apart
Push hips back with a neutral spine
Knees slightly bent
Stop when hamstrings tension is felt
compound_movements.reference: McGill SM. Low Back Disorders. Human Kinetics. Cook G. Movement: Functional Movement Systems. 2011.
progressions: Dowel hinge -> Bodyweight -> Load -> Tempo

breathing_exercises.name: 90-90 Breathing
breathing_exercises.target: Diaphragm, deep core, ZOA (Zone of Apposition)
breathing_exercises.description: Foundational breathing drill to position the diaphragm and activate deep core. Core corrective for APT and dysfunctional breathing patterns.
execution: Supine with hips and knees at 90 deg, feet on wall
Low back gently flat to the floor (posterior pelvic tilt)
Inhale through the nose for 4 seconds, expand the ribs laterally
Exhale through the mouth for 8 seconds (as if through a straw)
Pause 3 seconds before the next inhale
3-5 sets x 5 breathing cycles
cues: Exhale fully until the abs engage
progressions: Basic 90-90 -> Balloon exhale -> Arms overhead -> Quadruped

breathing_exercises.name: Diaphragmatic Breathing / Bear Down
breathing_exercises.description: Corrective exercise diaphragmatic breathing to reinforce core stability (McGill, DNS).
execution: Supine with knees bent
Hands on abdomen and chest
Inhale to expand the abdomen 360 deg
Exhale while maintaining gentle core tension
progressions: Supine 90-90 -> Seated -> Standing -> Add bracing

hip_mobility_exercises.name: Hip Hinge / RDL (Bilateral Romanian Deadlift)
hip_mobility_exercises.description: Fundamental hinge pattern for hip mechanics. Builds skill for deadlifts and other hinge-based lifts.
execution: Stand with feet hip-width apart
Push the hips back with a soft knee bend
Maintain a neutral spine throughout
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch
Return by driving the hips forward and squeezing glutes
3 sets x 10-12 reps
progressions: Dowel on back -> Bodyweight -> KB/DB -> Barbell

hip_mobility_exercises.name: Hip Thrust
hip_mobility_exercises.description: High-output glute exercise with large ROM and loading potential. Ideal for glute strength and hip extension power.
execution: Upper back on a bench, feet flat
Drive hips up to full extension
Hold a strong glute squeeze for 2 seconds
Lower under control
3-4 sets x 10-15 reps
progressions: Glute bridge -> Bodyweight hip thrust -> Loaded -> Band + load

hip_mobility_exercises.name: Quadruped Rock Back
hip_mobility_exercises.description: Hip flexion mobility drill that separates hip from lumbar motion. Great for squat depth and hinge mechanics.
execution: Quadruped with hands under shoulders, knees under hips
Keep spine neutral
Rock hips back toward heels
Stop before pelvic tuck (butt wink)
3 sets x 10-15 reps
progressions: Basic -> Add pause -> Add rotation -> Deep squat

hip_mobility_exercises.name: 90-90 Hip Stretch
hip_mobility_exercises.description: Multiplanar hip stretch for internal and external rotation control.
execution: Seated with front leg at 90 deg external rotation
Back leg at 90 deg internal rotation
Stay tall and hinge toward the front leg
Switch sides by rotating over the hips
3 sets x 30-45 seconds per side
progressions: Static -> Add hinge -> Transitions -> Loaded

hip_mobility_exercises.name: Hip CARS (Controlled Articular Rotations)
hip_mobility_exercises.description: Controlled articular rotations to build active hip ROM and joint control.
execution: Quadruped or standing with support
Lift knee toward chest (flexion)
Open outward (abduction + external rotation)
Extend backward
Close inward (adduction + internal rotation)
Slow, controlled full circle
5-10 reps each direction per hip
cues: Isolate the hip; avoid lumbar motion
common_errors: Loss of control at end range
progressions: With support -> No support -> Add resistance -> Larger range

hip_mobility_exercises.name: Piriformis Stretch
hip_mobility_exercises.description: Targeted stretch for piriformis and deep external rotators.
execution: Supine figure-4 position (ankle over opposite knee)
Draw the base knee toward the chest
Gently press the crossed knee outward
Hold 45-60 seconds per side
Repeat 2-3 times
progressions: Supine -> Seated figure-4 -> Pigeon pose

hip_mobility_exercises.name: Active Hamstring Stretch
hip_mobility_exercises.description: Active hamstring stretch using reciprocal quad activation for functional range.
execution: Supine with one leg extended on the floor
Actively raise the other leg with the knee straight
Keep ankle dorsiflexed
Hold 2-3 seconds at the top, lower slowly
3 sets x 10-12 reps per leg
cues: Contract the quad to keep the knee straight
Pelvis stays heavy on the floor
progressions: Active -> Assisted with band -> PNF contract-relax -> Straight leg lowering

hip_mobility_exercises.name: Hamstrings Contract-Relax Stretch
hip_mobility_exercises.description: PNF-style hamstring mobility drill. Emphasize submaximal contraction and full relaxation between cycles. Avoid posterior pelvic tuck collapse.
execution: Position: supine with one leg raised (use strap/towel behind the foot if needed).
Move to the first mild stretch barrier (no pain).
Gently push the heel down into the strap (hamstring contraction) 6–10 seconds at ~50–70% effort.
Relax completely 2–3 seconds.
Increase hip flexion slightly to a new mild barrier.
Repeat 3–4 cycles per side.
cues: Keep pelvis as neutral as possible (don't crank into posterior tilt)
common_errors: Forcing end range and losing pelvic control
progressions: Strap-assisted -> partner-assisted (gentle) -> add isometric hold at new range (5–10 sec)
hip_mobility_exercises.reference: PNF contract-relax. Knott M, Voss DE. Proprioceptive Neuromuscular Facilitation: Patterns and Techniques. Harper & Row. Kabat, Knott, Voss.

hip_mobility_exercises.name: Hip Flexors Contract-Relax Stretch
hip_mobility_exercises.description: PNF stretch for hip flexors (Knott, Voss).
execution: Half-kneeling position
Isometric hip flexor contraction for 6-10 seconds
Relax and move deeper into the stretch
Repeat 3-4 cycles
progressions: Light contraction -> Longer contractions -> Add reach -> Add band

shoulder_mobility_exercises.name: Wall Angels
shoulder_mobility_exercises.target: Thoracic mobility, scapular control, shoulder flexion
shoulder_mobility_exercises.description: Wall-supported shoulder mobility drill to improve thoracic extension and scapular mechanics.
execution: Stand with back, head, and hips against a wall
Keep ribs down and low back gently neutral
Place arms in a goal-post position against the wall
Slide arms upward while keeping elbows and wrists on the wall
Return to start with control for 8-12 reps
cues: Move slowly and stay within pain-free range
common_errors: Wrists or elbows leaving the wall
progressions: Reduce range -> Full range -> Add foam roller behind mid-back

shoulder_mobility_exercises.name: Doorway Pec Stretch
shoulder_mobility_exercises.description: Classic pec stretch to reduce rounded shoulders. Arm angle changes bias different fibers.
execution: Stand in a doorway with forearm on the frame
Elbow at 90 deg, shoulder at 90 deg abduction (mid pec)
Step forward until a stretch is felt
Adjust arm angle lower or higher for different fibers
Hold 45-60 seconds per position per side
cues: Do not arch the low back
progressions: Bilateral -> Unilateral -> Add thoracic rotation

shoulder_mobility_exercises.name: Sleeper Stretch
shoulder_mobility_exercises.description: Posterior shoulder capsule stretch. Key for overhead athletes with GIRD.
execution: Side-lying on the shoulder being stretched
Shoulder and elbow at 90 deg, forearm vertical
Use the opposite hand to gently press the forearm toward the floor
Hold 30-45 seconds, 3-4 sets
cues: Scapula stays pinned to the floor
progressions: Basic sleeper -> Cross-body stretch -> Add mobilization

shoulder_mobility_exercises.name: 90/90 Shoulder Internal Rotation Stretch
shoulder_mobility_exercises.description: Controlled internal rotation stretch in the 90/90 position to improve IR range.
execution: Lie supine with shoulder abducted to 90 deg and elbow flexed to 90 deg
Keep the scapula stable against the floor
Slowly rotate the forearm toward the floor into internal rotation
Stop at a mild stretch and hold 30-45 seconds
Repeat 2-3 sets per side
cues: Move slowly and stay below pain
Do not let the shoulder roll forward
progressions: Static hold -> Light contract-relax -> Add towel roll under arm

shoulder_mobility_exercises.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
shoulder_mobility_exercises.description: Gentle posterior shoulder stretch. A safer alternative to the sleeper stretch for some clients.
execution: Bring the arm horizontally across the body
Use the opposite hand to draw the arm toward the chest
Keep the shoulder down
Hold 30-45 seconds per side
cues: Feel the stretch in the back of the shoulder
progressions: Basic -> Against a wall -> Add rotation

shoulder_mobility_exercises.name: Banded Pull-Apart
shoulder_mobility_exercises.description: Scapular retractor and external rotator activation. Great pre-press warm-up.
execution: Hold a band with arms straight in front
Pull the band apart by moving the arms to the sides
Squeeze the shoulder blades together at the end
Control the return
3-4 sets x 15-20 reps
progressions: Light band -> Medium -> Heavy -> Pause -> Overhead pull-apart

shoulder_mobility_exercises.name: Prone Cobra
shoulder_mobility_exercises.target: Cervical extensors, thoracic extensors, mid/lower trapezius
shoulder_mobility_exercises.description: Global extension drill to counter kyphotic posture. Strengthens the upper posterior chain.
execution: Prone with arms at the sides
Lift the chest with thoracic extension
Externally rotate the arms (thumbs up)
Retract scapulae and tuck the chin
Hold 10-15 seconds, 3 sets x 5-8 reps
cues: Extend from the thoracic spine, not the lumbar
progressions: No hold -> With hold -> Arms in Y -> Light load

shoulder_mobility_exercises.name: Downward Dog
shoulder_mobility_exercises.description: Yoga-derived position for posterior chain length and shoulder opening.
execution: From quadruped, lift hips up and back
Form an inverted V shape
Press hands into the floor
Heels reach toward the floor (not required to touch)
progressions: Short holds -> Longer holds -> Add calf pedal -> Flow

shoulder_mobility_exercises.name: Chest Opener
shoulder_mobility_exercises.description: Corrective exercise chest opener to reduce rounded shoulders using gravity-assisted stretch.
execution: Supine on a foam roller lengthwise
Arms at different angles (90, 135, 180 deg)
Let the arms fall toward the floor
Hold 60-90 seconds per position
progressions: Short holds -> Longer holds -> Add breathing emphasis -> Add rotation

ankle_mobility_exercises.name: Ankle CARS (Controlled Articular Rotations)
ankle_mobility_exercises.description: Controlled articular rotations to restore ankle mobility and control in all directions.
execution: Seated with the leg supported or crossed
Draw slow, full circles with the foot
Maximize range without moving the knee
10 circles each direction per ankle
progressions: Seated -> Standing -> Add resistance

ankle_mobility_exercises.name: Toe Yoga
ankle_mobility_exercises.description: Toe dissociation drill to improve intrinsic foot control and arch function.
execution: Barefoot, seated or standing
Lift the big toe while keeping the other toes down
Then lift the four toes while keeping the big toe down
Alternate with control
2-3 sets x 10-15 reps each pattern
progressions: Seated -> Standing -> Single leg -> During gait

ankle_mobility_exercises.name: Big Toe Stretch
ankle_mobility_exercises.target: Hallux extension mobility (1st MTP), plantar fascia line
ankle_mobility_exercises.description: Mobility drill to improve big toe extension for gait and push-off. Useful when limited hallux extension contributes to compensatory pronation or reduced ankle mechanics.
execution: Stand facing a wall or use a step. Place the big toe on the wall/step so it extends upward while the ball of the foot stays down.
Keep knee tracking over the 2nd toe and arch gently active.
Lean forward slightly to increase stretch at the big toe base.
Hold 20–40 seconds, 2–3 rounds per side.
cues: Pressure through the ball of the foot, not collapsing the arch
Mild stretch, no sharp joint pain
common_errors: Arch collapse / overpronation during the stretch
Rolling the ankle outward/inward to cheat
Forcing into painful joint end range
progressions: Short holds -> longer holds
Add gentle oscillations at end range
Progress to toe-off drills once ROM improves

ankle_mobility_exercises.name: Foot Inversion Stretch
ankle_mobility_exercises.description: Controlled inversion bias stretch to restore balanced foot motion when the system is stuck in pronation-dominant mechanics. Keep it gentle and controlled.
execution: Seated: cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Stabilize the lower leg with one hand.
With the other hand, gently guide the forefoot toward inversion (sole turns slightly inward).
Hold 15–30 seconds, 2–3 rounds per side.
Option: add very small oscillations near end range if pain-free.
cues: Move the foot, not the whole leg
Stay in a tolerable stretch zone
common_errors: Twisting the knee/hip instead of isolating the foot
progressions: Static hold -> small oscillations -> integrate into short-foot + controlled pronation/supination drills

ankle_mobility_exercises.name: Wall Ankle Mobilization
ankle_mobility_exercises.description: Corrective exercise wall ankle mobilization for dorsiflexion.
execution: Foot about 4 inches from the wall
Drive knee toward the wall without lifting the heel
Repeat 10-15 reps each side
cues: Knee tracks over the middle toe
progressions: Short range -> Full range -> Add pause -> Add load

core_advanced_exercises.name: Bear Position / Crawl
core_advanced_exercises.description: Quadruped hover that challenges core stability and contralateral coordination. Base for crawling patterns.
execution: Quadruped, then lift knees 2-3 inches off the floor
Maintain a neutral spine and braced core
For crawling, move opposite hand and foot together
Use small, controlled steps
3 sets x 20-30 seconds static or 10 steps each direction
cues: Knees hover just off the floor
progressions: Static hold -> Forward crawl -> Backward -> Lateral -> Add obstacles

core_advanced_exercises.name: Hard Style Plank
core_advanced_exercises.description: High-tension plank variation to create full-body stiffness.
execution: Forearm plank position
Squeeze glutes as hard as possible
Drive elbows toward the feet without moving
Brace quads and lats
Hold 10-20 seconds at max tension
cues: Brace as if you are about to be hit
progressions: Knees plank -> Standard -> Hard style bracing -> Weighted

additional_smr.name: Glute/Piriformis Foam Rolling
additional_smr.description: SMR for glutes and piriformis to reduce hip tension and prep for mobility work.
execution: Sit on a foam roller and cross one ankle over the opposite knee (figure-4)
Lean toward the working glute
Roll slowly over the glute max
For piriformis, roll slightly deeper and more lateral
Pause 20-30 seconds on tender spots
2 minutes per side
progressions: Foam roller -> Lacrosse ball for precision

additional_smr.name: Upper Trap/Levator SMR (Ball)
additional_smr.description: Ball release for upper trap and levator scapulae. Useful for chronic neck tension and FHP.
execution: Stand against a wall with a ball on the upper trap
Lean into the wall to apply pressure
Move the ball toward the neck for levator
Hold 60-90 seconds on tender points
Optional: slowly raise/lower the arm
common_errors: Too much pressure on the neck
Ball too close to the cervical spine
progressions: Static -> Add arm motion -> Add cervical rotation

additional_smr.name: Plantar Fascia Ball Rolling
additional_smr.description: Plantar fascia release with a ball. Helpful for plantar fasciitis and foot stiffness.
execution: Standing or seated with a ball under the foot
Roll from heel to the ball of the foot
Apply moderate pressure with body weight
Pause 20-30 seconds on tender spots
2-3 minutes per foot
cues: Spend extra time on the medial arch if needed
common_errors: Rolling without pausing on tender points
progressions: Soft ball -> Hard ball -> Frozen ball

additional_smr.name: Hamstring Foam Rolling
additional_smr.description: Hamstring SMR to reduce posterior chain stiffness and prep for mobility work.
execution: Sit on a foam roller with hands behind for support
Roll from below the glutes to above the knees
Rotate the leg slightly in and out to target different fibers
Pause on tender spots
2-3 minutes per leg
progressions: Both legs -> Single leg -> Lacrosse ball

additional_smr.name: Thoracic Spine Foam Rolling
additional_smr.description: Thoracic SMR targeting paraspinals. Different from extension work; focus is soft-tissue release.
execution: Supine with foam roller perpendicular under the shoulder blades
Arms crossed or behind the head
Roll slowly from T1 to T12
Pause on stiff segments
2-3 minutes
progressions: Soft roller -> Hard roller -> Double lacrosse balls

additional_smr.name: Posterior Shoulder Ball Release
additional_smr.target: Posterior shoulder capsule and rotator cuff
additional_smr.description: Soft tissue release for the posterior shoulder using a ball.
execution: Stand against a wall with a ball at the back of the shoulder
Slowly roll over tender spots
Hold pressure 20-30 seconds per spot
Breathe slowly and stay relaxed
Repeat 1-2 minutes per side
progressions: Larger ball -> Smaller ball

additional_smr.name: Pectoralis Ball Roll
additional_smr.target: Pectoralis minor and major, pec fascia
additional_smr.description: Corrective exercise pec release with a ball for localized myofascial work.
execution: Stand against a wall with a lacrosse ball on the pec
Find tender points and hold pressure 60-90 seconds
Add slow arm movement while maintaining pressure
progressions: Larger ball -> Lacrosse ball -> Longer holds -> Add arm movement

additional_smr.name: TFL Ball Roll
additional_smr.description: Corrective exercise TFL release with a lacrosse ball.
execution: Side-lying with the ball on the TFL
TFL is just below the anterolateral iliac crest
Hold pressure on tender points
60-90 seconds per side
cues: Find the spot just below the hip bone
progressions: Larger ball -> Lacrosse ball -> Longer holds -> Add movement

additional_smr.name: Plantar Fascia Ball Roll
additional_smr.description: Corrective exercise plantar fascia roll with a small ball.
execution: Standing or seated with a small ball under the foot
Roll from heel to forefoot
Apply moderate pressure on tender points
2-3 minutes per foot
progressions: Light pressure -> Firm pressure -> Longer duration -> Add toe extension

additional_smr.name: Calf Ball Roll
additional_smr.description: Corrective exercise calf release with a lacrosse ball.
execution: Seated with calf on the ball
Cross the other leg to add pressure
Roll from Achilles to knee
Pause on tender spots
cues: Rotate to cover medial and lateral calf
Move the ankle over tender points
progressions: Light pressure -> Firm pressure -> Longer duration -> Add ankle pumps

elbow_forearm_exercises.name: Wrist Extensor Isometric Hold
elbow_forearm_exercises.description: Isometric loading for wrist extensors to reduce pain and build tolerance.
execution: Support forearm on a table with palm down
Extend the wrist into a neutral position against light resistance
Hold 30-45 seconds without pain flare
3-5 holds with 60 seconds rest
cues: Keep the elbow relaxed and forearm supported
progressions: Increase load
Increase hold duration
Transition to eccentric loading

elbow_forearm_exercises.name: Wrist Extensor Eccentrics
elbow_forearm_exercises.description: Eccentric loading for wrist extensors to promote tendon adaptation.
execution: Support forearm with palm down and hold a light dumbbell
Use the opposite hand to assist into wrist extension
Slowly lower into wrist flexion over 3-5 seconds
2-3 sets of 8-12 reps
cues: Use minimal pain as a guide
progressions: Increase load
Add concentric phase

elbow_forearm_exercises.name: Forearm Extensor Stretch
elbow_forearm_exercises.description: Gentle stretch to reduce extensor tone and improve wrist flexion range.
execution: Extend the elbow with palm down
Use the opposite hand to flex the wrist
Hold 20-30 seconds
2-3 repetitions
progressions: Increase hold duration

elbow_forearm_exercises.name: Forearm Extensor Soft Tissue Release
elbow_forearm_exercises.description: SMR to reduce extensor tightness and improve tissue mobility.
execution: Place a ball under the extensor mass on the forearm
Apply gentle pressure while moving the wrist
Slowly scan tender areas
30-60 seconds per side
progressions: Increase time
Add gentle wrist motion

elbow_forearm_exercises.name: Wrist Flexor Isometric Hold
elbow_forearm_exercises.description: Isometric loading for wrist flexors to reduce pain and build tolerance.
execution: Support forearm on a table with palm up
Flex the wrist into a neutral position against light resistance
Hold 30-45 seconds without pain flare
3-5 holds with 60 seconds rest
progressions: Increase load
Increase hold duration
Transition to eccentric loading

elbow_forearm_exercises.name: Wrist Flexor Eccentrics
elbow_forearm_exercises.description: Eccentric loading for wrist flexors to promote tendon adaptation.
execution: Support forearm with palm up and hold a light dumbbell
Use the opposite hand to assist into wrist flexion
Slowly lower into wrist extension over 3-5 seconds
2-3 sets of 8-12 reps
progressions: Increase load
Add concentric phase

elbow_forearm_exercises.name: Forearm Flexor Stretch
elbow_forearm_exercises.description: Gentle stretch to reduce flexor tone and improve wrist extension range.
execution: Extend the elbow with palm up
Use the opposite hand to extend the wrist
Hold 20-30 seconds
2-3 repetitions
progressions: Increase hold duration

elbow_forearm_exercises.name: Forearm Flexor Soft Tissue Release
elbow_forearm_exercises.description: SMR to reduce flexor tightness and improve tissue mobility.
execution: Place a ball under the flexor mass on the forearm
Apply gentle pressure while moving the wrist
Slowly scan tender areas
30-60 seconds per side
progressions: Increase time
Add gentle wrist motion

elbow_forearm_exercises.name: Forearm Pronation/Supination AROM
elbow_forearm_exercises.description: Active range of motion drill to restore forearm rotation control.
execution: Sit with elbow at 90 degrees and forearm supported
Rotate palm up to full supination, then palm down to full pronation
Move slowly through available range
2-3 sets of 8-12 reps
progressions: Add light resistance
Increase range gradually

elbow_forearm_exercises.name: Forearm Pronation Stretch
elbow_forearm_exercises.description: Gentle stretch to improve pronation range by lengthening supinators.
execution: Elbow at 90 degrees, forearm supported
Use the opposite hand to rotate the forearm into pronation
Hold 20-30 seconds
2-3 repetitions
progressions: Increase hold duration

elbow_forearm_exercises.name: Forearm Supination Stretch
elbow_forearm_exercises.description: Gentle stretch to improve supination range by lengthening pronators.
execution: Elbow at 90 degrees, forearm supported
Use the opposite hand to rotate the forearm into supination
Hold 20-30 seconds
2-3 repetitions
progressions: Increase hold duration
